verdict.rationale: Gusto's Embedded Payroll API covers extensive UI-equivalent operations (onboarding, payroll runs, off-cycle payroll, contractor payments, time off, benefits, tax config) and offers React SDK/UI flows as alternatives to custom UI, plus official client libraries and an MCP server for AI-native access to the API/docs. However, evidence doesn't confirm full parity — some flows (e.g., 401k/Guideline, benefits enrollment) explicitly rely on pre-built partner UI flows rather than pure API access, suggesting certain UI-only actions aren't fully API-exposed. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that every UI-only action (e.g., admin approval interfaces, benefits enrollment via third parties) has a full API equivalent, and independent/hands-on verification that the API achieves full UI parity rather than requiring embedded UI components.
